title: The Voice Is Heard
summary: A voice is heard throughout this land. It cries woe, warns the inhabitants to repent, and speaks of the slain sons and daughters of its people.

explicit_facts.text: A voice is heard among all the inhabitants upon all the face of this land.
The voice cries woe to this people and the inhabitants of the whole earth unless they repent.
The voice says the devil laughs and his angels rejoice because of the slain sons and daughters of its people.
The voice attributes their fall to their iniquity and abominations.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Inhabitants may be shown hearing the voice without its source being visible.
unspecified_visual_details: The voice’s identity and appearance are not established by these verses.
The inhabitants’ individual appearances and surroundings are not specified.

spoken_dialogue.text: Wo, wo, wo unto this people; wo unto the inhabitants of the whole earth except they shall repent;
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Unidentified voice

spoken_dialogue.text: for the devil laugheth, and his angels rejoice,
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Unidentified voice

spoken_dialogue.text: and it is because of their iniquity and abominations that they are fallen!
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Unidentified voice

narration.text: there was a voice heard among all the inhabitants of the earth,

doctrinal_or_story_notes: These verses do not name the speaker; a later identification cannot be introduced as dialogue here.
The devil and his angels are mentioned by the voice, not narrated as visible participants.
prohibited_inventions: Do not identify or visibly depict the voice’s source.
Do not depict the devil or his angels as present.
Do not stage the slain people’s deaths as a present event.

title: Zarahemla Burned
summary: The voice says that Zarahemla and its inhabitants were burned with fire.

explicit_facts.text: The voice says it burned Zarahemla and its inhabitants with fire.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The city may be shown burning as an illustration of the reported destruction.
unspecified_visual_details: The appearance of the city, its inhabitants, and the circumstances of the burning are unspecified.

spoken_dialogue.text: that great city Zarahemla have I burned with fire,
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The destruction is reported by the voice; it is not a newly occurring event in the present setting.
prohibited_inventions: Do not invent individual inhabitants, actions, or details of the fire.

title: Moroni Sunk
summary: The voice says that Moroni was sunk into the sea and its inhabitants drowned.

explicit_facts.text: The voice says Moroni was caused to sink into the depths of the sea and its inhabitants drowned.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The city may be represented beneath the sea to illustrate the reported destruction.
unspecified_visual_details: The city’s appearance and the manner in which it sank are unspecified.

spoken_dialogue.text: that great city Moroni have I caused to be sunk
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The destruction is reported rather than staged as a present event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict drowning individuals or invent details of the sinking.

title: Moronihah Covered
summary: The voice says that Moronihah and its inhabitants were covered with earth.

explicit_facts.text: The voice says Moronihah and its inhabitants were covered with earth.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Earth covering the city can illustrate the reported destruction.
unspecified_visual_details: The city’s appearance and the manner of covering are unspecified.

spoken_dialogue.text: that great city Moronihah have I covered with earth,
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The voice explains that this hides iniquities and abominations.
prohibited_inventions: Do not show identifiable inhabitants or add details of the event.

title: Gilgal Sunk
summary: The voice says that Gilgal and its inhabitants were sunk and buried in the depths of the earth.

explicit_facts.text: The voice says Gilgal was caused to sink and its inhabitants were buried in the depths of the earth.

reasonable_visual_inferences: A sunken city may illustrate the reported destruction.
unspecified_visual_details: The city’s appearance and the manner of sinking are unspecified.

spoken_dialogue.text: the city of Gilgal have I caused to be sunk,
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The destruction is recounted by the voice.
prohibited_inventions: Do not show individual inhabitants or invent details of the sinking.

title: Cities Replaced by Waters
summary: The voice names Onihah, Mocum, and Jerusalem, saying their inhabitants were destroyed and waters came up in their place.

explicit_facts.text: The voice names the cities of Onihah, Mocum, and Jerusalem and their inhabitants.
The voice says waters came up in their place.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The three cities may be shown as separate inset illustrations of water occupying their places.
unspecified_visual_details: The cities’ appearances and the sequence or manner of destruction are unspecified.

spoken_dialogue.text: and waters have I caused to come up in the stead thereof,
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

doctrinal_or_story_notes: This verse names three cities in one summarized report; it does not specify separate moments.
prohibited_inventions: Do not invent a sequence of destruction or show named cities as a single geographic location.

title: Four Cities Sunk
summary: The voice says Gadiandi, Gadiomnah, Jacob, and Gimgimno were sunk, leaving hills and valleys where they had been.

explicit_facts.text: The voice says the four named cities were sunk, hills and valleys made in their places, and their inhabitants buried in the depths of the earth.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Separate small views may illustrate the named cities and the altered terrain in their places.
unspecified_visual_details: The cities’ appearances and the exact geography of the hills and valleys are unspecified.

spoken_dialogue.text: all these have I caused to be sunk,
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verse reports multiple city destructions without specifying their order.
prohibited_inventions: Do not combine the cities into one location or invent a chronological sequence.

title: Jacobugath Burned
summary: The speaker says he caused Jacobugath, inhabited by the people of king Jacob, to be burned with fire because of their sins and wickedness.

explicit_facts.text: Jacobugath was inhabited by the people of king Jacob.
The speaker says he caused Jacobugath to be burned with fire because of its inhabitants' sins and wickedness.
The speaker says the people destroyed the peace of his people and the government of the land.

unspecified_visual_details: The speaker's appearance and location are not stated.
Jacobugath's appearance and the identities of individual inhabitants are not stated.

spoken_dialogue.text: And behold, that great city Jacobugath, which was inhabited by the people of king Jacob, have I caused to be burned with fire because of their sins and their wickedness, which was above all the wickedness of the whole earth, because of their secret murders and combinations;
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The burning is reported as an event already caused, not an event occurring during the speech.
prohibited_inventions: Do not place the speaker at Bountiful or give him an appearance.
Do not stage secret murders, combinations, or the burning as events occurring during this speech.

title: Four Cities Burned
summary: The voice says Laman, Josh, Gad, and Kishkumen were burned with their inhabitants because they cast out prophets and stoned those sent to them.

explicit_facts.text: The voice says the four named cities and their inhabitants were burned with fire.
The voice says the people cast out prophets and stoned those sent to declare their wickedness, and that fire was sent down to destroy them.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The cities may be represented in separate small views; the burning is a reported event.
unspecified_visual_details: The prophets’ identities, the cities’ appearances, and the timing of these events are unspecified.

spoken_dialogue.text: I did send down fire and destroy them,
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The voice connects the destruction with the people’s rejection of prophets.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the earlier stoning or portray fire striking people in graphic detail.

title: Many Destructions
summary: The voice says many great destructions came upon the land and its people because of wickedness and abominations.

explicit_facts.text: The voice says many great destructions came upon the land and its people because of wickedness and abominations.

reasonable_visual_inferences: A restrained overview of altered land may suggest the reported destructions.
unspecified_visual_details: The locations and appearances of the additional destructions are not specified.

spoken_dialogue.text: many great destructions have I caused to come upon this land,
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

doctrinal_or_story_notes: This is a summary statement, not a newly specified destruction event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not invent additional named cities or particular disasters.

title: Call to Repentance
summary: Those spared are called to return, repent, be converted, and come to the speaker, who promises healing, eternal life, and a welcome to those who come.

explicit_facts.text: The speaker addresses those spared because they were more righteous than others and calls them to return, repent, and be converted.
The speaker promises eternal life to those who come to him and says he will receive them.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The speaker may remain unseen while those spared listen.
unspecified_visual_details: The location, number, and appearance of those spared are not specified.
The speaker's visible appearance is not described.

spoken_dialogue.text: will ye not now return unto me, and repent of your sins, and be converted, that I may heal you?
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

spoken_dialogue.text: if ye will come unto me ye shall have eternal life.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Healing and eternal life are promised, not shown as events.
prohibited_inventions: Do not place the speaker at Bountiful or depict him visibly.
Do not show a healing miracle.

title: Jesus Christ Identifies Himself
summary: Jesus Christ identifies himself as the Son of God and speaks of creation, his relationship with the Father, and his coming to his own, who did not receive him.

explicit_facts.text: The speaker identifies himself as Jesus Christ, the Son of God, and says he created the heavens and the earth and was with the Father from the beginning.
He says he is in the Father and the Father is in him.
He says he came to his own, who did not receive him, and that the scriptures concerning his coming are fulfilled.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The speaker can remain off-screen because no visible appearance is described.
unspecified_visual_details: The speaker’s appearance, the listeners, and the setting are not specified.

spoken_dialogue.text: I am Jesus Christ the Son of God.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

spoken_dialogue.text: I came unto my own, and my own received me not.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The claims about creation, the Father, and his coming are speech, not separately narrated visible events.
prohibited_inventions: Do not assign Jesus Christ a location or visible appearance not stated in these verses.
Do not stage creation or his rejected coming as present events.

title: Redemption and Fulfillment
summary: Jesus Christ says that those who receive him are given to become sons of God, extends this to those who believe on his name, and declares that redemption comes through him and the law of Moses is fulfilled in him. He identifies himself as the light and life of the world, Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus Christ says he has given those who receive him to become sons of God and will do likewise for those who believe on his name.
He says redemption comes through him and the law of Moses is fulfilled in him.
He identifies himself as the light and life of the world, Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The words may be presented without showing the speaker.
unspecified_visual_details: The speaker’s appearance and location are not described.

spoken_dialogue.text: And as many as have received me, to them have I given to become the sons of God;
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

spoken_dialogue.text: by me redemption cometh, and in me is the law of Moses fulfilled.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

spoken_dialogue.text: I am the light and the life of the world. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The descriptions of light, life, Alpha, and Omega are teachings, not narrated visual events.
prohibited_inventions: Do not assign a location or visible appearance to the speaker.
Do not depict the teachings as literal supernatural events.

title: A New Offering
summary: Jesus Christ declares that sacrifices and burnt offerings are done away and calls for a broken heart and a contrite spirit. He promises baptism with fire and the Holy Ghost to those who come to him in that way and refers to the Lamanites’ earlier conversion.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus Christ says sacrifices and burnt offerings are done away and will not be accepted.
He calls for a broken heart and a contrite spirit and promises to baptize those who come to him with them with fire and the Holy Ghost.
He says the Lamanites were baptized with fire and the Holy Ghost at the time of their conversion because of their faith, and they knew it not.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The teaching can be presented as speech without showing the speaker or a baptism.
unspecified_visual_details: The location, listeners, and speaker’s visible appearance are not specified.

spoken_dialogue.text: your sacrifices and your burnt offerings shall be done away
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

spoken_dialogue.text: And ye shall offer for a sacrifice unto me a broken heart and a contrite spirit.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The Lamanites’ conversion is mentioned retrospectively, not narrated as a present event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not place the scene at Bountiful or depict a sacrifice, baptism with fire, the Holy Ghost’s appearance, or the Lamanites’ earlier conversion as a present event.

title: Come as a Little Child
summary: Jesus Christ declares that he came to bring redemption and save the world from sin. He invites people to repent and come unto him as a little child, and says he laid down his life and took it up again.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus Christ says he came to bring redemption and save the world from sin.
He says he will receive those who repent and come unto him as a little child.
He says he laid down his life and took it up again, and invites the ends of the earth to repent and be saved.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The speaker may remain off-screen while his words are heard.
unspecified_visual_details: The speaker’s appearance, listeners, and setting are not described.

spoken_dialogue.text: Behold, I have come unto the world to bring redemption unto the world, to save the world from sin.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

spoken_dialogue.text: Therefore, whoso repenteth and cometh unto me as a little child, him will I receive, for of such is the kingdom of God.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

spoken_dialogue.text: therefore repent, and come unto me ye ends of the earth, and be saved.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Coming as a little child is part of the teaching, not a narrated scene involving a child.
The laying down and taking up of life are spoken of retrospectively; neither event occurs in this scene.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a child, the crucifixion, the resurrection, or a visible appearance of Jesus Christ.
Do not identify the location as Bountiful.
